verdict.rationale: WHOIS privacy is a fair question for a domain registrar, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Porkbun provides free, default-on WHOIS privacy or redaction. The only WHOIS-related items describe an RDAP lookup page and server for finding contact information, which is an adjacent feature and does not show privacy protection.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, WHOIS privacy is free and on by default — my name, address, and email stay redacted without an upsell
